what: On hover, mono uppercase links and buttons get a 2px dotted box 5px outside the text, appearing in .25s and disappearing on release. “look: underline” is for links inside titles: an always-visible dotted underline becomes a four-sided dotted box on hover. Keyboard focus shows the same box, replacing the focus indicator.

options.--fx-gap: Distance the boxes spread outside the text, default 5px
options.look: underline: Dotted underline → four-sided dotted border (inline link)

use: COMPANY VALUES · Name

from.where: All pages .tb-mono-link · .tb-btn-link (dotted box) · .tb-head-link (dotted underline → box) — original border .25s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1)
